g.text: Known material and its saved FEM field — qualification worlds
These are the known qualification materials and already-solved f=1 FEM total fields, not reconstructions. Dashed rectangle: fixed query region.
Display uses at most 12,000 saved quadrature points per label, deterministically subsampled; no nodal approximation or phase interpolation.
